sections.content: How many people are "travel agency managers and proprietors"?

11,070 people

were counted on the census as "travel agency managers and proprietors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Travel agency managers and proprietors direct and co-ordinate the resources and activities of travel agencies and booking offices.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 45 to 49 years. Of the whole working population 11% were aged 45 to 49 years. For people working as "travel agency managers and proprietors", 14.7% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "travel agency managers and proprietors" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "travel agency managers and proprietors" included:

  • charitable organisation managers and directors
  • managers and proprietors in other services (other)
  • managers and directors in the creative industries

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

A similar number of men and women had this job

Among people working as "travel agency managers and proprietors" there were a similar number of men and women (48.8% compared with 51.2%).

This means "travel agency managers and proprietors" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "other managers and proprietors".

Men made up 48.8% and women made up 51.2% of "travel agency managers and proprietors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "travel agency managers and proprietors" included:

  • hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors
  • textiles, garments and related trades (other)
  • other vocational and industrial trainers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "travel agency managers and proprietors", 6.9% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (65.6% compared with 34.4%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (72.5%) than self-employed (27.5%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Wandsworth, this is in the same region of London.
